summary: CP-003 implementation verification: 55 automated checks passed, TypeScript validation and production build passed, plus browser verification at compact and desktop widths.

automated.command: node --import tsx --test test/requirement-history.test.mjs test/requirement-history-api.test.mjs test/requirement-history-store.test.mjs test/tagging.test.mjs test/tagging-api.test.mjs test/mcp-api.test.mjs test/mcp-store.test.mjs test/workflow-api.test.mjs

checks.title: Requirement inspection and lifecycle summary
checks.detail: Browser: selected requirement retains context when history closes; lifecycle summary shows absolute zoned times with the recorded revision, and unknown legacy dates. Verified desktop inspector at 1440px and compact timeline at 390px.

checks.title: Recent activity links to durable history
checks.detail: Unit tests retained 105 events after 510 unrelated activity entries capped the recent feed at 500. Browser confirmed structured activity links including deleted requirement HQ-002. Legacy free-text entries remain unlinked.

checks.title: Atomic durable change provenance
checks.detail: Unit/API/D1 tests cover every editable field, original staged creation, atomic multi-requirement application, deletion, actual saved before/after values, trusted actors and reported client metadata, no-op saves, stale/invalid rejection, rollback and idempotent replay across worker replacement.

checks.title: Distinct creation, acceptance and lifecycle milestones
checks.detail: Tests cover initial Draft/Approved/Implemented, Draft→Approved→Draft→Approved, direct Implemented without invented approval, stable proposal-addition creation, acceptance independent of status, and later direct revisions retaining earlier milestone revision IDs.

checks.title: Accessible timeline and historical navigation
checks.detail: Browser: keyboard opening and diff expansion, proposal/snapshot navigation and repeat round-trip, deleted identity, complete and partial histories, empty legacy history, loading, 50→53 entry pagination, compact 390px layout, and successful Retry after an actual local service outage. Timeline shows historical values and review notes.

checks.title: Legacy and import provenance without rewriting snapshots
checks.detail: Tests verify pure repeated legacy reads, snapshot-only first-observed dates, unknown original lifecycle dates, preserved local events when imports omit or forge history, import revision gaps, unchanged frozen snapshots/evidence and metadata-only no-op revisions. No automatic historical-event recovery is attempted.

checks.title: Read-only history across API and MCP
checks.detail: Tests validate the 16-tool discovery catalog, get_requirement lifecycle output, matching REST/MCP history, deleted IDs, unknown IDs, bounded pagination, deterministic ordering, query-bound cursors, concurrent invalidation, forged write metadata and overlapping project IDs. Existing MCP authentication-rejection tests pass.

checks.title: Executed requirement-linked verification
checks.detail: 55 automated checks passed with zero failures in the final suite; TypeScript and production build passed. UI checks ran against local preview and compiled Worker. D1 failures were deliberately injected and expected rejection/rollback was verified. Hosted OAuth audience/revocation behavior was not re-tested; existing hosting controls are unchanged.

verification_scope: Implementation and tests cover CP-003 at BL-004. This report does not mark requirement lifecycle status Implemented, certify unrelated requirements, or claim automatic recovery of unavailable historical events.
